# uptimekuma_notification_homeassistant (Resource)

Home Assistant notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_homeassistant" "example" {
  name                    = "Home Assistant Notifications"
  is_default              = false
  apply_existing          = false
  home_assistant_url      = "https://homeassistant.example.com"
  long_lived_access_token = "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9"
  notification_service    = "notify.mobile_app"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: long_lived_access_token_wo is
# never stored in plan or state. Change long_lived_access_token_wo_version
# whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_homeassistant" "write_only" {
  name                 = "Home Assistant with write-only token"
  home_assistant_url   = "https://homeassistant.example.com"
  notification_service = "notify.mobile_app"

  long_lived_access_token_wo         = "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9"
  long_lived_access_token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `home_assistant_url` (String, Sensitive) Home Assistant URL
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `notification_service` (String) Home Assistant notification service name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `long_lived_access_token` (String, Sensitive) Home Assistant long-lived access token. Stored in state; use `long_lived_access_token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `long_lived_access_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Home Assistant long-lived access token, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `long_lived_access_token`; requires `long_lived_access_token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `long_lived_access_token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `long_lived_access_token` until the next apply with `long_lived_access_token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `long_lived_access_token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `long_lived_access_token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `long_lived_access_token_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
